    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Each quadrant contains the input multiset; use distinct cyclic row/column shifts.

            rr=(r%h + br + bc) % h
            cc=(c%w + br*2 + bc) % w
            out[r][c]=grid[rr][cc]
